    export/empty: import makes no file of this export, so its product is empty, and list reads an empty view.

        + rejected
        The cells past import fail in normal runs until the frozen cell is resolved: an update writes them from what import makes now, and leaves the cell's committed outcome and product in place, which a normal run reads.
        If the gap is closed, remove the line, and the next update writes the cell. If the wrong behavior changed shape, delete the cell's files and its product, under out/import/ and via/import/, and the next update writes them.
